programmes.title: Active year bonus 2027
programmes.description: A bonus for members who stay active through 2027 and go to their yearly check-up. The member joins in the patient portal. The hub works out inside the member's record whether the year's goal was met; AlphaKasse receives the programme, the year and goal met yes or no. Steps, heart rate, diagnoses and visit details never leave the record. A no changes nothing in the member's contract.
programmes.ruleDescription: Goal met when, in the calendar year, the member was active for at least 150 minutes a week on average and went to one check-up. Read from the activity the member's tracker shares into the record and from the check-up in the member's own EHR. Evaluated by the hub inside the record; the member sees the result before anything is sent.

legalBasis: Primary use the person directs, EHDS Art. 2(2)(d) and 7(3); explicit consent, GDPR Art. 9(2)(a) (ADR-080)
